page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-90 is a memory-optimized server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor using the x86_64 architecture. It features 90 dedicated vCPUs derived from 45 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system is equipped with 720.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier multi-core CPU performance, with stress-ng multi-core and PassMark CPU scores placing in the top 10%. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and cryptographic acceleration. Memory read bandwidth is strong, reaching 6374.57 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 218.2 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. However, memory write bandwidth for large blocks is average at 77.77 GB/sec, and single-core performance benchmarks, such as Geekbench single-core, fall within the middle 50% range.

Given the high memory density and strong multi-core capabilities, this server is configured for memory-intensive workloads, database operations, and software compilation. It demonstrates strong performance in Redis SET operations and static web serving. The absence of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, which is a key architectural tradeoff for disk-heavy applications.
